info.title: PostHog's public endpoints: capture, flags, remote config and surveys
info.description: Written from PostHog's capture service's routes and answers (rust/capture), its API documentation (docs/api/capture, docs/api/flags) and its source (spec/SOURCE.md). PostHog's OpenAPI document leaves out these public, project-token endpoints.
